## Task

Describe the task clearly and concisely.

## Why This Is Useful

Explain why this improvement would be useful to AllTick developers or users.

## Suggested Approach

If possible, describe a possible implementation or documentation approach.

## Relevant Area

- Documentation
- API Examples
- WebSocket Examples
- REST API Examples
- Symbol Documentation
- Developer Experience
- Testing
- Other

## Acceptance Criteria

The task is considered complete when:

- [ ] The requested change has been implemented.
- [ ] Relevant documentation has been updated if necessary.
- [ ] Examples or tests have been updated if applicable.

## Additional Context

Add any additional information that may help a contributor complete this task.
